headline: Pin the search box to the panel, and tell your sequences apart at a glance.
notes: New: pin Search in Filters and the search box sits above the list in the Project view, the Active cut view and a bin
New: search works in a bin, narrowing its clips by name
New: other current sequences are tagged ALT SEQUENCE, so they're easy to tell apart from old ones
Old versions of a sequence are now tagged OLD SEQUENCE
